repository.name: seaweedfs-session-revocation
repository.description: SeaweedFS STS Session Revocation：支持 Filer 持久化撤销记录及 RevokeSession IAM 接口。实现说明：https://github.com/xx025/seaweedfs-session-revocation/issues/1

repository.name: seaweedfs-copy
repository.description: SeaweedFS is a fast distributed storage system for blobs, objects, files, and data lake, for billions of files! Blob store has O(1) disk seek, cloud tiering. Filer supports Cloud Drive, xDC replication, Kubernetes, POSIX FUSE mount, S3 API, S3 Gateway, Hadoop, WebDAV, encryption, Erasure Coding. Enterprise version is at seaweedfs.com.
